summary: Practise GS1 identifiers, event data and partner controls through product traceability cases. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: GS1-based product traceability connects identifiers, tracking events, and data elements into a usable record of product movement. It is for supply-chain and quality managers, procurement teams, and warehouse and distribution leads who need to design and improve workflows across trading partners. Participants map identifiers to Critical Tracking Events and Key Data Elements, assess EPCIS event records, reconcile partner data, and define receiving, dispatch, and exception controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who specify, operate or assure product identification and traceability across supply, storage, production and distribution workflows.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with supply-chain, quality, procurement, warehouse or distribution processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
